What I changed in Change Stack

CodeRabbit Change Stack · Formbricks #8650 · Parth Pawar

I kept the layer-based review model and focused on staying oriented while checking an explanation against code. The original already has summary navigation and explicit viewed status. I changed their presentation and added a return path for one cross-file inspection.

What got in the wayWhat I changed
File identity and controls compete with the code.All nine layer paths stay in the rail. A compact heading and one file toolbar leave more height for code. Copy path and the six captured access.ts entities remain in Tools.
A broad summary range leaves the supporting statement to find.The full six-point source summary has direct code links. Inspect guard opens the captured access check in feedback-access.ts; Return to access.ts restores the caller. Anchors are manually mapped.
File context and layer context need different scopes.This file and Entire layer make that choice explicit. The layer view groups 14 captured summaries across nine file paths and discloses coverage against the source total of 37.
Sample progress can look like completion of the whole PR.The header tracks seven included diffs; the rail tracks nine layer files. Viewed remains deliberate, with Undo. The merged snapshot disables Submit review; a separate open-PR demo shows that flow.

Keep the code readable

Wrapped 13 px code trades horizontal movement for vertical scrolling. Added-file Split uses a 96 px Before rail; Equal panes restores 50/50. A direct anchor is a starting point: surrounding code and the complete source summary stay available.

Checks and limits

I checked direct code links, guard/return navigation, context scopes, progress and Undo, notes, Copy path, the six entities and keyboard access. The 1440 px, 1280 px and 1100 px layouts passed. These are implementation checks; developer testing remains outstanding.

What I’d test next

I’d ask developers to explain the workspace access check, follow it into the guard, and return to the caller. I’d watch where they lose their place or confuse file, layer and sample progress. Modified-file review still needs work.
